card.name: Before alpha-blocker names and hCG
card.fires_on: Commas or 'or' in lists of alpha-blocker drugs (prazosin, terazosin, tamsulosin), and the first letter of hCG or FOLLISTIM after 'urinary' or 'of'.

modes.label: Alpha-blocker lists
modes.description: Comma, period or 'or' just before the next alpha-blocker name in a list of drugs like doxazosin, terazosin, alfuzosin.

modes.label: Start of hCG or FOLLISTIM
modes.description: The first letter of hCG or FOLLISTIM in fertility dosing text, after 'urinary', 'and' or 'of'.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the start of a specific drug name, though the promoted tokens are not clearly meaningful.
card.plain: It fires where the next drug name in a list of alpha-blockers or fertility hormones is about to appear.
